description: MCP server to read, edit, and look up audio file metadata (ID3/Vorbis) from an LLM chat. mutagen + MusicBrainz.
readmeMarkdown:
# audio-tag-mcp

An [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server that lets an LLM client (Claude
Code, etc.) **read, edit, and look up audio file metadata** over stdio — so you
can fix tags by just asking in chat ("set the album on these tracks to *Doves*").

Built on [mutagen](https://mutagen.readthedocs.io) for tag I/O and the
[MusicBrainz API](https://musicbrainz.org/doc/MusicBrainz_API) for filling in
missing values. Supports MP3 (ID3), FLAC/OGG (Vorbis), and M4A/MP4.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `read_tags(path)` | Normalized tags + **every raw frame** (incl. custom ones like a `producer` TXXX) + duration/bitrate. |
| `write_tags(path, title?, artist?, album?, …, dry_run?)` | Update **only** the fields you pass; everything else (incl. custom frames) is preserved. |
| `write_tags_bulk(paths, …, dry_run?)` | Same updates across many files (e.g. one album → a whole folder). |
| `clear_tags(path, dry_run?)` | Strip all tags (audio untouched). |
| `scan_directory(directory, recursive?, required_fields?)` | List files and flag which are missing a field (default: `album`). |
| `lookup_release(artist, title?, limit?)` | Read-only MusicBrainz suggestions for album / date / track number. |

Typical flow: `scan_directory` → (optional) `lookup_release` → `write_tags`.

## Safety

Writes save **in place with no undo.** Use `dry_run=True` to preview the
before/after diff, and keep backups / work on copies for bulk edits.

## Install & register in Claude Code

```sh
uv sync
claude mcp add -s user audio-tag -- uv run --directory C:/Projects/audio-tag-mcp audio-tag-mcp
```
On Windows, use forward slashes in the path — backslashes get stripped by the shell during arg parsing and the server fails to start.

Then in any Claude Code chat:

> Scan `C:\Music\manymen` for files missing album, and set the album to "Doves".

## Develop

```sh
uv run pytest          # offline unit + smoke tests
uv run audio-tag-mcp     # run the stdio server directly
```

Tests synthesize tiny silent MP3s in a temp dir (no encoder needed). The
MusicBrainz lookup is exercised live only when you pass `--live`.

## Layout

```
src/audio_tag_mcp/
  server.py        # build_server() -> FastMCP; main()
  tags.py          # mutagen read/write/clear/scan helpers
  musicbrainz.py   # async httpx client for MusicBrainz WS2
  tools/edit.py    # read_tags / write_tags / clear_tags / scan_directory
  tools/lookup.py  # lookup_release
```
